quote_boxes.t_raw: Nara와 Paimon? Aranakula는 Arapandu를 따라 Ashavan Realm에 갔는데 아직 돌아오지 않았으니, 우리 지금 버섯 좀 먹는 게 어때?
quote_boxes.en: Nara and Paimon? Aranakula followed Arapandu to Ashavan Realm and still hasn't returned, so why don't we eat some mushrooms now.
